University arts departments ineligible; Architecture, Arts Management and PGCE/teacher-training courses ineligible.

title: Art Scholarship Training Opportunities for Under 18s
amount_raw: Max total award £475,000 per institution plus 5% admin contribution
eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities evidencing outstanding teaching in fine/performing arts (music, drama, dance, film, fine art). Non-specialist arts schools and multi-faculty universities ineligible; individuals may not apply. One application per organisation per round.
summary: Funds arts training for under-18s outside regular school hours (weekends, evenings, holidays), via specialist arts institutions; triennial.

title: Early Career Fellowships
amount_raw: Salary: 100% up to £56,000 yr1, 50% up to £28,000 yr2–3 (host pays balance); + up to £6,000/yr research expenses. At-a-glance headline £130,000
eligibility_summary: Early career researchers without a full-time permanent academic post; doctorate by take-up, thesis submitted for viva by the closing date and not >4 years prior (career-break exceptions). Tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers; main residence UK.
summary: Three-year fellowships for early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research at a UK university (~145 fellowships in 2027).

summary: Supports retired/semi-retired senior researchers to complete a research project and prepare results for publication (£3k–£24k, 3–24 months).

eligibility_summary: Institutional applicant: a UK university with its own research degree awarding powers (or a consortium of up to two); one lead university and principal applicant. Applications not accepted directly from graduates.
summary: Awards to UK universities to fund up to 30 doctoral scholarships in an interdisciplinary priority area; ten awards up to £5m each, 9-year grants (Centenary round).

title: Leverhulme Research Centres
amount_raw: Up to £10 million over up to 10 years (at-a-glance: '£1m per year')
eligibility_summary: UK universities registered with the OfS holding their own research degree awarding powers; single or multi-institution. One application as principal applicant per university. In the Centenary round Oxford, Cambridge and Imperial become eligible.
summary: For UK universities to establish a Leverhulme Research Centre for original 'blue-skies' multidisciplinary research; up to £10m over 10 years; two-stage (outline then detailed).
notes: Own page 'Currently closed for outline applications / Opens February 2027 / Closes June 2027'. Staged (multi_deadline). Month-only dates (uncertain). One-bid-per-institution (restricted).

title: Major Research Fellowships
eligibility_summary: Employed at an eligible UK university with research degree awarding powers; well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences. Previous MRF holders ineligible.
summary: Fellowships for distinguished humanities/social-science researchers to complete original research; funds replacement salary for 2–3 years plus up to £6,000/yr expenses.

eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers with a permanent post/long-term fellowship at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; normally ≤10 years since doctorate (career-break exceptions). Nominations made by the head of department; ≤3 nominations per institution per subject.
summary: Prizes of £100,000 (over 2–3 years) for early-career researchers with international impact, for any research purpose; six rotating subject areas per year.

title: Research Fellowships
eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers in any discipline holding a post at a UK university with research degree awarding powers, resident in the UK, with an established record. Excludes independent scholars, those registered for degrees, and wholly research-focused posts.
summary: Fellowships (≤£70,000, 3–24 months, ~100/year) for experienced UK-based researchers to complete original research; now also covers international-focus projects after the International Fellowships scheme was discontinued.

title: Research Leadership Awards

Must not have held an equivalent group-establishing award or >£100k single grant. One bid per institution.
summary: Awards for early career scholars to build and lead a research team on a distinctive problem; up to £1m over 4–5 years (Centenary round next).
